Private Function Digest(wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim s As String, sh As Worksheet, pt As PivotTable, cell As Range
    On Error Resume Next
    s = "caches " & wb.PivotCaches.Count & " active " & ActiveSheet.Name
    For Each sh In wb.Worksheets
        s = s & " <" & sh.Name
        For Each pt In sh.PivotTables
            s = s & " {" & pt.Name & " " & pt.TableRange2.Address(False, False) & " v" & pt.Version & " c" & pt.PivotCache.Index
            s = s & " cv" & pt.PivotCache.Version & " " & pt.PivotCache.SourceData & " grand " & pt.RowGrand & pt.ColumnGrand
            s = s & " auto " & pt.HasAutoFormat & " save " & pt.SaveData & " zones " & pt.InGridDropZones
            s = s & " style " & pt.TableStyle2 & " layout " & pt.LayoutRowDefault & " " & pt.CompactLayoutRowHeader
            s = s & " drill " & pt.ShowDrillIndicators & " edit " & pt.EnableDataValueEditing
            For Each cell In pt.TableRange2
                If cell.Text <> "" Then s = s & " " & cell.Address(False, False) & "=" & cell.Text
            Next
            s = s & "}"
            Err.Clear
        Next
        s = s & ">"
    Next
    Digest = s
End Function

Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim sink As New ExcelSink, wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, pt As PivotTable, r As Variant, failure As String
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:C5").Value = ws.Evaluate("{""k"",""g"",""v"";""a"",""x"",1;""b"",""y"",2;""a"",""y"",3;""b"",""x"",4}")
    ws.Activate
    ws.Range("A1").Select
    Set sink.Book = wb
    Log = ""
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1"))
    Case 1
        ws.Range("B2").Select: Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard()
    Case 2
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"))
    Case 3
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1"), "Mine")
    Case 4
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1"), RowGrand:=False, ColumnGrand:=False)
    Case 5
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1"), HasAutoFormat:=False, SaveData:=False)
    Case 6
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, "Sheet1!R1C1:R5C3", ws.Range("E1"))
    Case 7
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1")): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.PivotFields("g").Orientation = xlColumnField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"): r = TypeName(pt)
    Case 8
        Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E1")): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.PivotFields("g").Orientation = xlColumnField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"): r = TypeName(pt)
    Case 9
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1")): Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E20"))
    Case 10
        ws.Range("E1").Value = "x": Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1"))
    Case 11
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlConsolidation, Array(ws.Range("A1:C5")), ws.Range("E1"))
    Case 12
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1")): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.PivotFields("g").Orientation = xlColumnField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"): ws.Range("F3").Select: Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(): r = pt.Name
    Case 13
        wb.Worksheets.Add After:=ws: Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), wb.Worksheets(2).Range("B2"))
    Case 14
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1"), TableName:="Mine", ReadData:=False)
    Case 15
        Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: pt.EnableDataValueEditing = True: Log = "": ws.Range("F2").Value = 99: r = ws.Range("F2").Value
    Case 16
        Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: Log = "": ws.Range("F2").Value = 99: r = ws.Range("F2").Value
    Case 17
        Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: pt.EnableDataValueEditing = True: Log = "": ws.Range("F2:F3").Value = 7: r = ws.Range("F4").Value
    Case 18
        Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: pt.EnableDataValueEditing = True: Log = "": ws.Range("F4").Value = 1: r = ws.Range("F4").Value
    Case 19
        Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: pt.EnableDataValueEditing = True: ws.Range("F2").Value = 99: Log = "": pt.RefreshTable: r = ws.Range("F2").Value
    Case 20
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1")): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField
    Case 21
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1")): pt.PivotFields("g").Orientation = xlColumnField
    Case 22
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1")): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.PivotFields("g").Orientation = xlColumnField
    Case 23
        Set pt = ws.PivotTableWizard(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:C5"), ws.Range("E1")): pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v")
    End Select
Answered:
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    If Not pt Is Nothing Then r = r & " ret " & pt.Name
    Probe = Log & "|" & CStr(r) & failure & "|" & Digest(wb) & "|at " & ActiveSheet.Name & "!" & ActiveCell.Address(False, False)
    On Error Resume Next
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    failure = "!E" & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Answered
End Function
